## CELL FACTS

Cell 火_伤官 (Fire carrying The Virtuoso). Persona The Virtuoso (伤官). Definition line: "Cross-current output, brilliance made of what it meets". Keyword Brilliance, charge fierce, poles catalyst Spark / friction Pushback. Family function: Expression. Cost dimension: brilliance against the grain; shining reads as defiance. Arena: the stage, spark, off-script, the note held too long. Classical portrait: brilliance and defiance; output that exceeds its container; 傲物气高, cannot hold its tongue. Ruled domains: Talent, Performance, Defiance. Sibling (other polarity of the family): 食神.
Element arena: Fire (flame, light, warmth, fuel, the hearth, the blaze). dm_element (which core reads this cell): Wood. structural_interaction seed: "Wood generating Fire cross-polarity — reach producing warmth that challenges frameworks".
- k2_overview: "Your Fire moves as the Virtuoso: light that must be seen. You are the flare, the show, the opinion that ignites the whole street, talent with a spotlight built in. Attention comes to you like oxygen and behaves like it too. Managed, you illuminate everything. Unmanaged, you are magnificent arson."
- k2_functional: "You express in fireworks: dazzling, loud, unforgettable, occasionally singeing the front seats."
- adj_chips: {"friction":["Provocative","Scene-stealing","Combustible"],"catalyst":"[REDACTED: the words under test]"}
- k2_domain_readings: {"Talent":"Your talent is incandescent and public: performing, persuading, lighting ideas so others finally see them. It needs an audience the way flame needs air. Book the stage instead of apologizing for wanting one.","Performance":"Performance is your natural habitat: the pitch, the stage, the moment all eyes turn. Rehearse enough to deserve the attention you attract. Brilliance plus preparation reads as destiny.","Defiance":"Your defiance burns visibly: the public no, the bridge lit for warmth. Some bridges deserve it. Count to ten anyway, and keep a fireproof list of the ones that lead home."}

- Sibling cell 火_食神 chips (nothing you write may fit the sibling): {"catalyst":["Radiant","Festive","Heartwarming"],"friction":["Comfort-chasing","Over the top","Slack"]}
- Sibling cell 火_食神 catalyst row 0 drive passage, for the sibling test on the tension (this row must name a different either-or): "Your enjoyment broadcasts. The good meal, the small win, the Tuesday sunset: whatever you savor gets amplified through you and lands on everyone nearby, brightening the whole table by contact. Joy in your hands is not private property. It is a utility, and you run the grid."

Core element Wood, energy element Fire. Law: Wood feeds Fire (木生火: dry branches make the flame). Relative to the core the energy is the fed, so Fire is this core's Expression. No chart is attached to this batch: the cell is written for every chart with a Wood core that shows Fire on the catalyst pole, so no percentage and no state of one chart appears in any value. The catalyst pole of Fire as the Expression is the Overfueled band's case (the core has more than it channels); tone by pole: compliment. Rows: row 0, row 1, row 2, each with its three angles (drive, cost_self, cost_others: the drive, the cost to the reader, the cost to others; the app shows one angle per row by position rotation, so each passage must stand alone); one chip per row, written once and copied byte-identical onto the row's three fields. The pair cell 木_火's definition and advice for this pole are rewritten in the same batch (the pair skeleton) and are withheld here; no four-word run may be shared with them, so keep every phrase the ledger's own.

value.text: You speak up right where it has gone quiet. You hear silence as agreeing, and you say the unsaid thing rather than sit with it. Keep speaking up, and own its price, since you are remembered for the sentence more than the care behind it.

value_b.text: Speaking up costs you less than staying quiet does. You carry an unsaid thing like a weight, and saying it comes sooner than wishing you had. Say it anyway, and mind the price, that you spend goodwill faster than you earn it.

value.text: Fast enough to finish other people's sentences, you usually do. Waiting for a thought to end feels like wasted time, and you answer ahead of hearing it all. Let the slow thought finish, because you cost the slower ones the rest of theirs.
